name: open hand technique
desc: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can manipulate your enemy's ki when you harness your own.

Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classfeatures.Item.5MwNlVZK7m6VolOH]{Flurry of Blows}, you can impose one of the following effects on that target:

It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.It must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, you can push it up to 15 feet away from you.It can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.
